propositions: _build_datacenter does not assert non-secret scope readiness (base_url, jira.project) at build time, deferring all validation to lazy _LazyDataCenterClient, creating asymmetry with _build_cloud's eager assert_cloud_scope_ready
assert_cloud_scope_ready enforces stricter email-format and non-empty-project checks than the legacy ambient assert_env_ready, but this intentional tightening is undocumented
_build_datacenter must call assert_datacenter_nonsecret_scope_ready to validate base_url and jira.project at build time while preserving lazy PAT and network validation

assert_cloud_scope_ready and JiraBackend.assert_env_ready docstrings must document that the stricter checks (email format, non-empty project) are canonical and intentional, not accidental drift from legacy
DC backend composition and build must succeed without JIRA_PAT present and without importing the [agents] extra, demonstrating preserved laziness after non-secret scope assertion is added
